title: Kafka Connect - consumer group vs share group
description: Finite, verified at-least-once KIP-1302 comparison. Ordinary left, share right. Never substitutes fetched/ACK counts for useful completed work.

panels.title: Kafka Connect: consumer groups vs share groups

options.content: Same input corpus and three input partitions. Ordinary group on the left; share group on the right. Experimental KIP-1302 Connect build; **at least once**. Empty or missing metrics remain unknown.

panels.title: Confirmed input publication by partition
panels.description: Successful producer acknowledgements for unique input jobs. This is offered load, not sink completion.

options.content: Distinct acquired records; sharing follows the selected broker policy

panels.title: Verified unique results / second - ordinary
panels.description: First correct output for each job ID, independently observed at the destination. Duplicates do not increase useful throughput.

panels.title: Verified unique results / second - share
panels.description: First correct output for each job ID, independently observed at the destination. Duplicates do not increase useful throughput.

panels.title: Tasks completing useful work in 30 seconds - ordinary
panels.description: Participation over a window; this does not prove those tasks ran simultaneously.

panels.title: Tasks completing useful work in 30 seconds - share
panels.description: Participation over a window; this does not prove those tasks ran simultaneously.

panels.title: Sampled concurrent processing tasks - ordinary
panels.description: Scraped work-in-progress gauges, including the awaited destination write. Failed scrape targets are excluded. Use the full-run processing-span overlap report for a stronger concurrency check.

panels.title: Sampled concurrent processing tasks - share
panels.description: Scraped work-in-progress gauges, including the awaited destination write. Failed scrape targets are excluded. Use the full-run processing-span overlap report for a stronger concurrency check.

panels.title: Verified result rate by task - ordinary
panels.description: Original task IDs from verified audit records. No completed output means no series; this does not by itself mean a task failed.

panels.title: Verified result rate by task - share
panels.description: Original task IDs from verified audit records. No completed output means no series; this does not by itself mean a task failed.

panels.title: Task x input partition - ordinary
panels.description: Verified unique results over the last 30 seconds. Cell shading shows actual work from each original input partition. Blank cells mean no observed series, not fabricated zeros.

panels.title: Task x input partition - share
panels.description: Verified unique results over the last 30 seconds. Cell shading shows actual work from each original input partition. Blank cells mean no observed series, not fabricated zeros.

panels.title: Who completes hot P0 records? - ordinary
panels.description: Actual P0 completion by task, separate from eligibility to fetch P0.

panels.title: Who completes hot P0 records? - share
panels.description: Actual P0 completion by task, separate from eligibility to fetch P0.

panels.title: Verified result rate by input partition - ordinary
Verified result rate by input partition - share
Unfinished jobs by input partition - ordinary
panels.description: Successfully published unique jobs minus correct unique outputs. This is comparable business backlog, not native source lag.

panels.title: Unfinished jobs by input partition - share
panels.description: Successfully published unique jobs minus correct unique outputs. This is comparable business backlog, not native source lag.

panels.title: End-to-end completion latency - ordinary
panels.description: Input publication timestamp to first correct output observation. Rolling histogram estimates include completed jobs only. Read with unfinished count and oldest unfinished age; exact full-run values are in the saved report.

panels.title: End-to-end completion latency - share
panels.description: Input publication timestamp to first correct output observation. Rolling histogram estimates include completed jobs only. Read with unfinished count and oldest unfinished age; exact full-run values are in the saved report.

panels.title: Oldest unfinished job age - ordinary
panels.description: Age of the oldest successfully published job without a verified correct output. This exposes work absent from completion histograms.

panels.title: Oldest unfinished job age - share
panels.description: Age of the oldest successfully published job without a verified correct output. This exposes work absent from completion histograms.

panels.title: Committed-offset lag
panels.description: Native Admin API measurement. These source-progress measures have different semantics; compare business backlog above. Unavailable share lag is omitted, never replaced with zero.

panels.title: Native share lag
panels.description: Native Admin API measurement. These source-progress measures have different semantics; compare business backlog above. Unavailable share lag is omitted, never replaced with zero.

panels.title: Joined group members - ordinary
panels.description: Membership does not prove partition assignment or processing activity.

panels.title: Joined group members - share
panels.description: Membership does not prove partition assignment or processing activity.

panels.title: Eligible members per partition - ordinary
panels.description: Ordinary assignments are exclusive. Share eligibility follows the broker assignor; default simple gives three per partition for 9 members / 3 partitions.

panels.title: Eligible members per partition - share
panels.description: Ordinary assignments are exclusive. Share eligibility follows the broker assignor; default simple gives three per partition for 9 members / 3 partitions.

panels.title: Share acquisitions in flight
panels.description: Broker acquisition state. In-flight records are not the same as executing jobs or all unfinished work.

panels.title: Share acquisition-lock timeouts / second
panels.description: Broker record-lease expirations for this share group. Read alongside renewals and processing deadlines.

panels.title: Share acknowledgements / second - broker-wide
panels.description: Broker-wide Accept/Release/Reject/Renew activity, not a per-task completion count. Renewal is not useful output.

panels.title: Admin collector health
panels.description: One means the latest native group query succeeded. Missing or failed native data is not interpreted as zero lag.

panels.title: JVM process CPU fraction - ordinary
panels.description: Raw OperatingSystem ProcessCpuLoad fraction. This is not CPU divided by the pod quota.

panels.title: JVM process CPU fraction - share
panels.description: Raw OperatingSystem ProcessCpuLoad fraction. This is not CPU divided by the pod quota.

panels.title: JVM heap usage / maximum - ordinary
panels.description: JVM heap only. Native memory and container page cache are not included.

panels.title: JVM heap usage / maximum - share
panels.description: JVM heap only. Native memory and container page cache are not included.

panels.title: Duplicate physical output occurrences - ordinary
panels.description: Additional physical output occurrences of an input identity. At-least-once recovery can produce duplicates; they remain visible.

panels.title: Duplicate physical output occurrences - share
panels.description: Additional physical output occurrences of an input identity. At-least-once recovery can produce duplicates; they remain visible.

panels.title: Invalid / unexpected output occurrences - ordinary
panels.description: Wrong payload, result or identity. A successful run must not hide these behind deduplication.

panels.title: Invalid / unexpected output occurrences - share
panels.description: Wrong payload, result or identity. A successful run must not hide these behind deduplication.

panels.title: Task processing failures / second - ordinary
panels.description: Plugin failures. Retry/write attempts are separate from verified unique completion.

panels.title: Task processing failures / second - share
panels.description: Plugin failures. Retry/write attempts are separate from verified unique completion.
